title: Data for 'Symbol-based residual certification of reduced and neural surrogates for tempered-fractional CGMY pricing'
description: Large data files of the reproducibility archive for the article Symbol-based residual certification of reduced and neural surrogates for tempered-fractional CGMY pricing (arXiv:2611.03463): full-order Galerkin reference trajectories, POD bases, offline tensors of the reduced residual certificate and the EIM of the symbol, POD-NN training data, and POD-NN network checkpoints (116 files, 29.0 GB, in five uncompressed tar archives). Each archive unpacks into the layout of the code repository (data/, checkpoints/); README_DATA.md describes the contents, the producing and consuming scripts, and the unpacking, and MANIFEST_DATA.sha256 lists the SHA-256 of each archive. Per-file hashes and regeneration commands are in results/MANIFEST.json of the code repository.
